Package uno.anahata.asi.nb.uc

package uno.anahata.asi.nb.uc
Root package for the standalone Anahata ASI NetBeans Update Center plugin.

Provides universal NetBeans version detection, dynamic Anahata update catalog registration, and a unified GUI for managing updates and installing Anahata ASI Studio.
